Wednesday Meander

Saltaire, United Kingdom · Social

No-drop

Wednesday Meander is a social group ride in Saltaire, United Kingdom. It rolls every Wednesday at 10:30 am local time from Cycle stands, Hirst Lane free car park. About 37 km (23 miles), easy; e-bikes welcome. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy; e-bikes welcome. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Wednesday Meander group ride

Weekday rides along waterways, greenways and quiet roads around Saltaire, with a refreshment break at the halfway point. E-bikes are fine, and the group says no one gets left behind. Sometimes it uses a rail station start for longer rides.
